title: He remembers
summary: The referee who has your name in his head is doing your game again. Whatever happened between you last time, he hasn't forgotten. A season on, he's doing his last one.

ends.title: Shook hands
ends.text: The referee who had your name in his head shook your hand on his last day.

ends.title: Arms folded
ends.text: You kept your arms folded at the referee's last game. There's a photo.

beats.title: The coin toss

event.title: The coin toss
event.speaker: referee
setup: {referee.name} is doing your game. At the coin toss he looks at you a second longer than he looks at anyone else.
{if mem(referee,'called-me-a-cheat')}Last time you called him a cheat in the tunnel.{/if}
{if mem(referee,'gave-me-a-fair-hearing')}Last time he heard you out, and he was fair.{/if}
{if mem(referee,'signed-my-lads-shirt')}You signed his son's shirt once.{/if}

say: "Afternoon. I'll be watching the arms at corners. Yours included. Clear?"
"I'm always fair. You'll get what you earn."

clear.text: He gives you two free kicks you'd have argued about any other week. In the seventy-ninth minute he books you for a shirt pull you did do.

cheek.text: He writes something on his card before the game's even started. Every fifty-fifty goes their way for half an hour.

beats.hint: The referee is doing your game again

beats.title: His last game

event.title: His last game
event.speaker: referee
setup: A season on. It's {referee.short}'s last game before he retires. Both teams are meant to clap him out.
{if arc.path=='cheek'}He sees you in the line and his face doesn't move.{/if}

choices.label: Clap him out with the rest.

outcomes.text: You clap. At full time he finds you in the tunnel and shakes your hand, which he's never done with anyone.
The cameras get it. A paper runs a picture of you with your arms folded and him walking past.

beats.hint: A season on, the referee's last game
